name: motion-studio
description: Reusable artwork-first cinematic motion graphics engine

scripts.showreel:v2:check: node scripts/check-showreel-v2.mjs && node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes check src/projects/style-showreel-v2 --json
scripts.showreel:v2:render: node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes render src/projects/style-showreel-v2 --fps 60 --quality delivery --workers 2 --no-best-effort --output out/showreel-v2/Motion-Studio-Beyond-the-Frame.mp4
scripts.showreel:check: node scripts/check-showreel.mjs && node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes check src/projects/style-showreel --json
scripts.showreel:render: node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes render src/projects/style-showreel --fps 60 --quality delivery --workers 2 --no-best-effort --output out/style-showreel/Motion-Studio-20-Styles.mp4
scripts.sfx:fetch: node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes media-use resolve --type sfx --provider openverse.audio
scripts.twenty-worlds:check: node scripts/check-twenty-worlds.mjs && node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes check src/projects/twenty-worlds --json
scripts.twenty-worlds:render: node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes render src/projects/twenty-worlds --fps 60 --quality delivery --workers 2 --browser-gpu --no-best-effort --output out/twenty-worlds/Motion-Studio-One-Idea-Twenty-Worlds.mp4
scripts.portfolio:check: node scripts/check-portfolio.mjs && node scripts/check-portfolio-graphics.mjs && node scripts/check-portfolio-transitions.mjs && node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes check src/projects/portfolio-film --json
scripts.portfolio:render: node scripts/audio-tool.mjs hyperframes render src/projects/portfolio-film --fps 60 --quality delivery --workers 2 --browser-gpu --video-frame-format png --no-best-effort --output out/portfolio-film/Souradip-Biswas-Bound-by-Curiosity.mp4
